title: 业务实现与应用交付
scope: 有限本机ProjectModel Web制品物化、构建、实际规则检查及新目录更新；通用业务命令、数据迁移和回滚保持设计。
implemented_scope: Python standard-library loopback server and standalone finite-domain/0.1 artifacts with ProjectModel edit/check/save/load, exact integers, version CAS, atomic single-file history and source/ownership manifests. Explicit four-file checker/protocol dependency closure is hash-checked before materialization; bundled v0.2 type support does not enable v0.2 target generation. New-directory updates preserve old releases and human files; incompatible data/rules, hashes or unsupported definition profiles reject. No general business command, migration, automatic rollback/crash recovery, remote integration or background business.
